summary: Push notifications (DailyHub AI iteration 30) tested — backend endpoints all pass (11/11) and frontend Profile 'Daily Reminder (9 AM)' toggle works and persists via backend. GET/PUT /api/push/prefs require auth and return correct defaults; PUT persists through subsequent GET. POST /api/admin/push/broadcast returns 403 for non-admin guest, 401 without auth, and 422 for empty title/message. POST /api/register-push returns 500 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY (EXPECTED per spec, not a bug). Frontend web preview loads normally without crash; expo-notifications web warning is informational only (web guard in _layout.tsx working as designed). Toggle row testID 'row-notif' present with correct label; toggling OFF and revisiting profile shows switch remains OFF (persisted via backend).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py line 2206: GET /api/push/prefs returns default true for new users (no push_users doc) — correct per spec.
backend/push.py: EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is read at module import time with 'placeholder' fallback — correct for test env; deploy pipeline injects the real key.

_layout.tsx line 33-39: setNotificationChannelAsync is called unconditionally (only setNotificationHandler is guarded by Platform.OS !== 'web'). On web this is a no-op with console warning only; non-blocking but could be moved inside the same web guard for cleanliness.

profile.tsx line 157-178 toggleNotif: sets legacy setNotifications(v) *before* calling backend setDailyReminderPref — if backend write fails the UI toast says 'Couldn't save' but legacy local pref is already flipped. Minor edge case, not critical.
seed_data_creation: Fresh guest user created per test module via POST /api/auth/guest (prefixed TEST_push_<uuid>). Push preference docs are tiny and left in db.push_users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push endpoints verified end-to-end. Actual push delivery NOT tested (works only on native builds post-deploy). Admin broadcast success path untested (no admin creds). If testing admin, use /app/memory/test_credentials.md ADMIN_EMAILS allow-list — not available in this env.
